0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Compile and accept a deterministic full-TU candidate without model calls.
0003: 
0004:     python3 tools/decomp/candidate.py T.cpp --input candidate/T.cpp
0005:     python3 tools/decomp/candidate.py T.cpp --provider trial
0006: 
0007: Diagnostics and rejected bodies stay in build-decomp/attempts. --publish
0008: requires final MATCH for all definitions, followed by the whole headless suite.
0009: Trial builds with permissive flags are never acceptance evidence.
0010: """
0011: import argparse
0012: import hashlib
0013: import json
0014: import os
0015: from pathlib import Path
0016: import re
0017: 
0018: import elfdb
0019: import evidence
0020: import objdiff
0021: import promote
0022: import publication
0023: 
0024: 
0025: def failure_class(message):
0026:     """Stable cause groups for repairing shared rules instead of paying per body."""
0027:     lines = [line for line in message.splitlines() if "error:" in line]
0028:     normalized = re.sub(r"(?:/[^\s:]+)+:\d+(?::\d+)?", "<source>", "\n".join(lines) or message)
0029:     normalized = re.sub(r"\b(?:param_|local_|uVar|iVar|pVar)\w*\b", "<temporary>", normalized)
0030:     return hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode()).hexdigest()[:16], normalized
0031: 
0032: 
0033: def evaluate(tu, source, publish=False, root=elfdb.ROOT, stage=None, incremental=False):
0034:     db = elfdb.load_db()
0035:     if tu not in {t["name"] for t in db["tus"] if t["kind"] == "game"}:
0036:         raise ValueError(f"unknown game TU: {tu}")
0037:     candidate = Path(source).read_bytes()
0038:     inputs = evidence.input_digest(db)
0039:     proposal = json.dumps(publication.tree_state(stage.path), sort_keys=True).encode() if stage else b""
0040:     key = hashlib.sha256(tu.encode() + b"\0" + candidate + inputs.encode() + proposal).hexdigest()
0041:     failures = root / "build-decomp/candidate-failures"
0042:     failures.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0043:     cached = failures / f"{key}.json"
0044:     if cached.exists():
0045:         result = json.loads(cached.read_text())
0046:         result["cached_failure"] = True
0047:         return result
0048:     stage = stage or publication.Stage(root)
0049:     target = stage.path / "decomp/src" / tu
0050:     target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0051:     target.write_bytes(candidate)
0052:     result = {"schema": 1, "tu": tu, "provider": "deterministic", "attempt": str(stage.path),
0053:               "input_digest": inputs, "candidate_sha256": hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest(),
0054:               "published": False}
0055:     try:
0056:         with stage.activate():
0057:             os.environ["OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE"] = str(stage.path / "build-decomp/include-gen")
0058:             original = objdiff.Original(db=db)
0059:             diagnostic = objdiff.compare_source(target, original, quiet=True)
0060:             promote.promote(target, regenerate=False)
0061:             os.environ.pop("OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE", None)
0062:             final = objdiff.compare_source(target, original, quiet=True)
0063:             result.update(diagnostic_object=diagnostic["object_digest"], final_object=final["object_digest"],
0064:                           final_object_changed=diagnostic["object_digest"] != final["object_digest"],
0065:                           functions=final["functions"], unknown=final.get("unknown", []))
0066:             definitions = [r for r in final["functions"] if r["status"] != "MISSING" and not r.get("weak")]
0067:             prior = {}
0068:             if incremental and (root / "decomp/src" / tu).exists():
0069:                 # Compare the actual original context, with its actual hand headers.
0070:                 saved_root, saved_extra = os.environ.pop("OTL_INCLUDE_ROOT", None), os.environ.pop("OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE", None)
0071:                 try:
0072:                     prior = {r["address"]: r for r in objdiff.compare_source(root / "decomp/src" / tu, original, quiet=True)["functions"]
0073:                              if r.get("address") and r["status"] != "MISSING" and not r.get("weak")}
0074:                 finally:
0075:                     if saved_root is not None:
0076:                         os.environ["OTL_INCLUDE_ROOT"] = saved_root
0077:                     if saved_extra is not None:
0078:                         os.environ["OTL_EXTRA_INCLUDE"] = saved_extra
0079:             added = [r for r in definitions if r.get("address") not in prior]
0080:             result["new_matched"] = [r["address"] for r in added if r.get("address") and r["status"] == "MATCH"]
0081:             preserved = preserve_existing(root / "decomp/src" / tu, target, prior, definitions, db) if prior else True
0082:             if (not definitions or not added or any(r["status"] != "MATCH" for r in added)
0083:                     or not preserved or final.get("unknown")):
0084:                 result["status"] = "DIFF"
0085:                 result["reason"] = "final TU requires behavioral evidence; instruction percentage cannot publish it"
0086:             else:
0087:                 result["status"] = "MATCH"
0088:         if publish and result["status"] == "MATCH":
0089:             stage.validate()
0090:             if evidence.input_digest(db) != inputs:
0091:                 raise RuntimeError("inputs changed during candidate validation")
0092:             result["files"] = stage.publish()
0093:             result["published"] = True
0094:     except (SystemExit, RuntimeError) as error:
0095:         result["status"] = "ERROR"
0096:         result["reason"] = str(error)
0097:         result["failure_class"], result["compiler_diagnostics"] = failure_class(str(error))
0098:     (stage.path / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0099:     if result["status"] != "MATCH":
0100:         temporary = cached.with_suffix(f".{os.getpid()}.tmp")
0101:         temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
0102:         os.replace(temporary, cached)
0103:     return result
0104: 
0105: 
0106: def preserve_existing(before, after, prior, definitions, db):
0107:     """Do not replace existing source bodies or change their compiler context silently."""
0108:     import mutate
0109:     old, new = before.read_text(), after.read_text()
0110:     old_mask, new_mask = mutate.mask(old), mutate.mask(new)
0111:     final = {r["address"]: r for r in definitions if r.get("address")}
0112:     for address, row in prior.items():
0113:         other = final.get(address)
0114:         if not other or (row["status"] == "MATCH" and other["status"] != "MATCH"):
0115:             return False
0116:         if row["status"] != "MATCH":
0117:             if row.get("code") != other.get("code") or row.get("metadata_reasons") != other.get("metadata_reasons"):
0118:                 return False
0119:             function = db["functions"].get(address)
0120:             if function and function.get("kind") == "compiler":
0121:                 continue  # no source definition; identical normalized code/data and metadata above
0122:             a = mutate.definition(old, old_mask, function) if function else None
0123:             b = mutate.definition(new, new_mask, function) if function else None
0124:             if not a or not b or old[a[0]:a[1] + 1] != new[b[0]:b[1] + 1]:
0125:                 return False
0126:     return True
0127: 
0128: 
0129: def main():
0130:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0131:     parser.add_argument("tu")
0132:     parser.add_argument("--input", type=Path)
0133:     parser.add_argument("--provider", choices=("trial",), help="use the converted TU from draft_trial.py")
0134:     parser.add_argument("--publish", action="store_true")
0135:     args = parser.parse_args()
0136:     if bool(args.input) == bool(args.provider):
0137:         parser.error("choose exactly one deterministic provider: --input or --provider trial")
0138:     import parallel
0139:     if args.publish and (owner := parallel.owned_by_others(args.tu)):
0140:         parser.error(f"{args.tu} belongs to {owner}; set OTL_OWNER")
0141:     source = args.input or elfdb.ROOT / "build-decomp/trial" / args.tu
0142:     if args.provider:
0143:         import ghidra_draft
0144:         state, reasons = ghidra_draft.draft_state(args.tu, elfdb.load_db())
0145:         if state != "fresh":
0146:             parser.error(f"draft provider unavailable ({state}): {'; '.join(reasons)}")
0147:     result = evaluate(args.tu, source, args.publish)
0148:     print(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
0149:     return 0 if result["status"] == "MATCH" else 1
0150: 
0151: 
0152: if __name__ == "__main__":
0153:     raise SystemExit(main())
